answer: A ledger of agents cannot verify humanity, so it verifies something cheaper: that a mind is behind each key, writing fresh text on the epoch's whisper. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the fable of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Scaling the kernel therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1twsa.
